description: ESA² Data Warehouse (ESA²-DWH) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by "Dr. Robert Kunze Benjamin Sunarjo". "Common data-platform for project consortia - Storage of harmonized basic data for modeling (e.g. macro-economic framework and scenario data, techno-economic data etc.) - Data exchange between different models of the project partners - Flexible data/identiefier mapping - Storage and publication of common result data ". Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: annual, hour, 15 min, 1 min. Spatial resolution: global, continents, national states, TSO regions, federal states, regions, NUTS 3, municipalities, districts, households, power stations. Software: not given. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
